blocks.text: Software development ek nizaam-wari (systematic) amal hai jo users ki zarooraton ko software products mein badalta hai. Is mein kai marahil (stages) hain, ibtidai tajziye (analysis) se le kar design, coding, testing aur deployment tak. Har marhale ki apni ahmiyat hai aur us ke liye khaas maharat aur tools chahiyein. Software development ka amal samajhna qabil-e-aitbar (reliable), aasani se sambhalne qabil (maintainable) aur barhne qabil (scalable) software banane ke liye zaroori hai.

Yeh chapter software development ke bunyadi tasawwurat se mutaarif karata hai, jin mein aham istilahat, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software development ke tareeqe (methodologies), project ki mansooba bandi (planning) aur intezam (management), quality assurance aur software design patterns shamil hain. Aakhir mein debugging, testing aur developers ke tools aate hain.

blocks.prompt: Software development kis cheez ko kis mein badalta hai, aur kin marahil se guzarta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh users ki zarooraton ko software products mein badalta hai, analysis, design, coding, testing aur deployment se guzarte hue, aur har marhale ke liye apni maharat aur tools chahiyein.

items: Software development: users ki zarooraton se software product tak nizaam-wari amal, analysis, design, coding, testing aur deployment ke zariye.
Chapter mein istilahat, SDLC, methodologies, planning aur management, quality assurance, UML, design patterns, debugging, testing aur tools hain.
